name: Giant Spider
description: The giant spider is a formidable arachnid, much larger than common spiders, known for its potent venom and web-spinning abilities. It is often found in dark, secluded areas like caves or dense forests, where it can create large webs to capture prey.

actions.name: Web
actions.description: The giant spider shoots out a sticky projectile web at a medium or smaller creature causing a creature's move speed to become 0 and have a -1 block and dodge penalty until they break free from the it. Any time the creature attempts to use an ability that allows them to move, they must make a strength check of 6 or higher. If they are successful, the web is broken, otherwise it remains.

actions.name: Spider Bite
actions.description: The giant spider bites a creature, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Inject Venom
actions.description: After scoring a true hit with the Spider Bite action, the giant spider injects their venom into a creature. The creature must make a resilience check of 8 or higher or they become poisoned for 1 minute, dealing 1d6 poison damage each round.

actions.name: Web Strand
actions.description: In response to falling, the giant spider can shoot a projectile of webbing at a surface within 4 units, immediately moving towards and attaching to that surface. This reaction can also be used on a huge or larger creature by making an attack check.

traits.name: Wall Climbing
traits.description: The giant spider has the ability to effortlessly climb and maneuver on walls and ceilings, allowing it to traverse any horizontal or vertical surface.
